notes:
Nyxen 1.0 Early Access

Nyxen is in early access: everything works and new builds arrive through the
app, but it is still growing. The version stays 1.0 Early Access while it does.

New figures in the Space: everyone is a chrome pictogram now - one smooth body
where the arms and legs grow out of round shoulders, a round head floating just
above, gunmetal chrome with a white shine from above. Chrome, glossy, jelly,
two-tone or oil-slick in any colour, and it still walks, sits, waves and dances.

The assistant's Speak button can be cancelled: while it listens it says Cancel -
click it again, or press Esc, and it stops at once without asking anything.

Also in this build: quick build (drag an area, pick a house, shop, office,
park, parking or road), ready-made walls and pieces, an easier hotbar and tool
row, first person, full screen, a Dark / White button, and a green mic over
whoever is talking.
